title: Unmerge: Efficient Machine Unlearning via Task Arithmetic
abstract: arXiv:2609.38895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Approximate machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of a forget set from a trained model without full retraining. Existing gradient-based methods require data-dependent hyperparameter search, struggle when forget and retain knowledge are entangled, and offer little insight into where unlearning actually happens inside the network. We recast unlearning through the lens of task arithmetic: if finetuning produces a merged task vector $\tau_m$ that combines learning on forget and retain sets, unlearning is the inverse operation that subtracts a learned forget component $\tau_F$ to recover the retain task vector $\tau_R$. The forget signal is concentrated: at every layer, forget activations lie in a subspace spanned by a handful of dominant directions, so we factorize $\tau_F$ in a low-rank forget basis, which is faithful up to a small tail-eigenvalue residual and limits how far the correction can perturb retain. translated_title: Unmerge：基于任务算术的高效机器遗忘
translated_abstract: 近似机器遗忘旨在无需完整重训练的情况下，从训练好的模型中移除遗忘集的影响。现有的基于梯度的方法需要依赖数据的超参数搜索，当遗忘知识与保留知识相互纠缠时表现不佳，并且对于遗忘在网络内部实际发生的位置几乎无法提供洞察。我们通过任务算术的视角重新审视机器遗忘：如果微调产生了合并遗忘集与保留集学习成果的任务向量 τ_m，那么遗忘就是其逆操作，即减去学习到的遗忘分量 τ_F 以恢复保留任务向量 τ_R。遗忘信号是高度集中的：在每一层中，遗忘激活都位于由少数主要方向张成的子空间内，因此我们在低秩遗忘基中对 τ_F 进行分解，该分解在小尾部特征值残差范围内是忠实的，同时限制了校正对保留知识的扰动程度。随后我们优化……
tldr: 将机器遗忘重新建模为任务算术的逆操作，通过对遗忘分量 τ_F 进行低秩分解来高效移除遗忘集的影响，同时保护保留知识并提升可解释性。
en_tdlr: Recasts machine unlearning as the inverse of task arithmetic, efficiently removing the forget set by low-rank factorizing the forget component τ_F while preserving retain knowledge and improving interpretability.
